The one systemic weakness: this lane's sharpest, most decisive claims (exact rustc diagnostic wording, f64 -0.0/NaN pattern edge cases, the 'Measured on 1.98.1' engine-integration asides) carry no sources[] citation at all -- their only warrant is the recipe's own embedded checks[] entry.
